directSourceFindings: workflow-schema.js classifies Stage 29 CALCULATE_EVIDENCE_CHAINS as an APPLICATION direct command with no external response envelope and an idempotent retry contract.
workflow-engine.js calculates the current evidence-chain set from current requirement/release/product/baseline/hash-review scope instead of trusting a favorable stored summary.
Stale release bindings and weak or missing evidence keep Stage 29 incomplete; exact idempotent retry returns the same current evidence-chain version without duplicating the authoritative receipt.
createPreDeliveryCheckpoint begins at BACKUP_PACKAGE_GENERATED, which cannot satisfy the terminal prerequisite.

recordPreDeliveryCheckpointExport requires current checkpoint-bound BACKUP_EXPORT_ACTION_COMPLETED evidence; nonexistent, generic, or fabricated evidence/checkpoint states are rejected without satisfying the terminal prerequisite.
app-core.js routes the operator checkpoint export through the engine-owned production transition rather than directly manufacturing canonical checkpoint custody.
repairedStateProofs: A complete current evidence-chain set is calculated application-side and stored under one current evidence-chain version; exact retry is idempotent.
A real pre-delivery checkpoint is created at BACKUP_PACKAGE_GENERATED and remains terminal-ineligible until export custody is supported by exact checkpoint-bound evidence.
After exact BACKUP_EXPORT_ACTION_COMPLETED evidence is recorded through the production transition, the current checkpoint becomes the sole terminal-eligible pre-delivery checkpoint.
